title: CRUMPETS
instructions: 1 pint raised dough.  3 eggs.  3 tablespoonfuls butter.  1/2 cup white sugar.  When your bread has passed its second rising, work into the above-named quantity the melted butter, then the eggs and sugar, beaten together until very light. Bake in muffin-rings about twenty minutes.
